//: Lighthouse CI runs against the built static output (dist/client) so dev-server quirks never affect scores. The url list is EXPLICIT on purpose: with staticDistDir alone, lhci auto-discovers pages but caps at 5, testing a near-random subset. Listing URLs covers every distinct template and skips non-page stubs. Accessibility is a HARD gate (must hold 100); performance / best-practices / SEO are warnings so normal CI variance doesn't block a PR. /studio, /preview/** and /api/** are SSR-only (or a bare React mount shell) and never audited here; the CMS-driven templates (/[slug] item categories, /legal/[slug]) only exist in a build that can reach Sanity, which the credential-less CI build cannot, so they are not listed either. See tests/routes.ts, which discovers them from dist/client when present. Run locally: npm run build && npx lhci autorun
